comments.body:
Installed Sepo infrastructure for `lm4sci/lm4sci.github.io`.

- PR: https://github.com/lm4sci/lm4sci.github.io/pull/2
- Source revision: `self-evolving/repo@v0.2.0`
- Source SHA: `810dfcaf206c03a805f4b3d072bf50900fe0d3ed`
- Release: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/releases/tag/v0.2.0
- Note: no non-draft stable release existed, so I used the latest non-draft prerelease.

Validation:
- Prepared fork-backed branch `agent/install-agent-infra`
- Audited `.github` paths; no same-path overwrite
- Preserved existing `.github/workflows/nextjs.yml`
- Excluded `.agent/dist/` and `.agent/node_modules/`
- Ran `git diff --cached --check`: passed
- Full Sepo test suite not run; this was a released infrastructure copy

Remaining setup after merge:
1. Install the Sepo GitHub App or choose another supported auth path.
2. Add `OPENAI_API_KEY` and/or `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`.
3. Run **Actions > Agent / Onboarding / Check Setup**.
4. Review the `Sepo setup check` issue.
5. Initialize `agent/memory` if missing.
6. Optionally initialize `agent/rubrics`.
